title: Just updated fishing 🎣 to my text based rpg game
author: charmander447
selftext: I am currently working on an idle rpg game. I am getting older and I don’t have a lot of time to play games anymore. So my solution is to make a really fun idle game that I can check for 5 minutes when I have time. Also if you need motivation I have been updating it on my lunch break every day because that’s all the free time I have 😂. I just added a lot of different fish and my plan is to create an aesthetically pleasing game you can just watch your stats go up and fight bosses and stuff, who doesn’t love fishing in games.
